1. Start with the inspection records.

completion:
Identify the failed SWTR and why
3. 2 individuals show up to inform residence of failed water quality and boiling is the only remedy
4. Explain water quality failure and the risk to community 
5. Offer to test water samples
6. Educate residence of harmfulness of the water quality results
7. Remind public that they may have to buy/drink bottled water in the interim
8. Give out pamphlets (English and Spanish)
9. Write press release for the local news, outlining the problem and your response to it


### What you will do

**1. Notify residents as soon as possible and then on 3 consecutive weeks**.
